description.plain_text: The LiveGroup node behaves similar to a Precomp node which contains its own subgraph and nodes, but behaves differently in that the contents may be published to an external nuke script. This can be used to break down large workflows into smaller, more manageable scripts which are then distributed out to artists for greater collaboration. Once a LiveGroup is published, the contents become locked which prevents any modifications to the subgraph. Exceptions to this are the Viewer node which can still be created and attached as normal, and knobs exposed on the LiveGroup nodes panel. When the LiveGroup node is editable, exposed knobs can be created by dragging and dropping knobs from the nodes within the subgraph, onto the LiveGroup node's panel, by using the Manage User knobs dialog or through the Python API with nuke.Link_Knob and setting the link to a knob inside the subgraph. Exposed knobs are also visible when the LiveGroup is opened in a separate Nuke session under the project settings panel. When the LiveGroup node is published with an exposed knob and the value of this knob changes, the exposed knob becomes an override knob. Override knobs are indicated by a yellow square in the node panel. When there are multiple knobs on a row, an overlapping icon is displayed which may be clicked to view the state of each of the knobs individually. Reloading the LiveGroup node will revert all changes made to the LiveGroup nodes contents, except for any override knobs, returning the LiveGroup to the state of the saved script. Using the context menu of an overriden knob, it is possible to revert individual overrides to the LiveGroup scripts value or (when editable) apply them to the LiveGroup script. The LiveGroup node also offers several Python callbacks which may be added to the node using node.addCallback: nuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_CAN_PUBLISH Executes before publishing when the contents are still editable, and prevents the action if the callback returns Falsenuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_PUBLISHED Executes after a successful publish action when the contents are lockednuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_CAN_MAKE_EDITABLE Executes before the LiveGroup is made editable when the contents are still locked, and prevents the action if the callback returns Falsenuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_MADE_EDITABLE Executes after the LiveGroup is made editable, when the contents are made editablenuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_RELOADED Executes when the LiveGroup has been reloadednuke.PRECOMP_CALLBACK_OPENED Executes when the LiveGroup has been opened in a separate Nuke session See also: LiveInput node.
description.text:
The LiveGroup node behaves similar to a Precomp node which contains its own subgraph and nodes, but behaves differently in that the contents may be published to an external nuke script. This can be used to break down large workflows into smaller, more manageable scripts which are then distributed out to artists for greater collaboration.

Once a LiveGroup is published, the contents become locked which prevents any modifications to the subgraph. Exceptions to this are the Viewer node which can still be created and attached as normal, and knobs exposed on the LiveGroup nodes panel.

When the LiveGroup node is editable, exposed knobs can be created by dragging and dropping knobs from the nodes within the subgraph, onto the LiveGroup node's panel, by using the Manage User knobs dialog or through the Python API with nuke.Link_Knob and setting the link to a knob inside the subgraph. Exposed knobs are also visible when the LiveGroup is opened in a separate Nuke session under the project settings panel.

When the LiveGroup node is published with an exposed knob and the value of this knob changes, the exposed knob becomes an override knob. Override knobs are indicated by a yellow square in the node panel. When there are multiple knobs on a row, an overlapping icon is displayed which may be clicked to view the state of each of the knobs individually.

Reloading the LiveGroup node will revert all changes made to the LiveGroup nodes contents, except for any override knobs, returning the LiveGroup to the state of the saved script. Using the context menu of an overriden knob, it is possible to revert individual overrides to the LiveGroup scripts value or (when editable) apply them to the LiveGroup script.

The LiveGroup node also offers several Python callbacks which may be added to the node using node.addCallback:

  • nuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_CAN_PUBLISH

    Executes before publishing when the contents are still editable, and prevents the action if the callback returns False

  • nuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_PUBLISHED

    Executes after a successful publish action when the contents are locked

  • nuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_CAN_MAKE_EDITABLE

    Executes before the LiveGroup is made editable when the contents are still locked, and prevents the action if the callback returns False

  • nuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_MADE_EDITABLE

    Executes after the LiveGroup is made editable, when the contents are made editable

  • nuke.LIVEGROUP_CALLBACK_RELOADED

    Executes when the LiveGroup has been reloaded

  • nuke.PRECOMP_CALLBACK_OPENED

    Executes when the LiveGroup has been opened in a separate Nuke session

See also: LiveInput node.
